changelog:
**Summary: Adds required AI-Mode integration and CLI version checks for robust skill invocation and compliance.**

- Introduced mandatory AI-Mode enable/disable steps for every command invocation, ensuring AI-mode is always explicitly toggled on at start and off at every exit point.
- Enforced required User-Agent header (`AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-resourcecenter-search`) on every CLI command.
- Increased minimum supported Aliyun CLI version to 3.3.3 and clarified installation/update procedures.
- Added requirement to always run `aliyun plugin update` to ensure plugins are current.
- Documented stricter command pre-check flow and enhanced security guidance.
- No impact to resource query or scenario logic; all core search and inventory features remain unchanged.
